messages:
maria-cs: Quick ask — I'm drafting a lightweight, customer-facing runbook for low-touch accounts heading into renewal. Focus: prefill + caching + streaming fallback so they keep fast UX without infra changes. Need a 1-pager + a tiny checklist that CSMs can run in 5–10m. anyone have a distilled set of steps?

sophie-ps: love this. can we make it prescriptive and tiered? e.g. 3 checks: prefill, batch size, streaming fallback. short bullets only. :white_check_mark:

ajay-eng: +1. Suggested minimal runbook (5–7 steps):
- verify account has hosted api keys active
- enable lightweight prefill (send 3 warmup reqs)
- set request header `X-Redwood-Warmup: 1` for warmup traffic
- configure client to use streaming + chunked render fallback
- tune client batch to 4 concurrent tokens / 8 reqs depending on qps
- enable expiry-based cache with 30s TTL for repeated prompts
- monitor key signals for 72h then handoff to AM

ajay-eng: quick curl sample we put in the doc: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'X-Redwood-Warmup: 1' -d '{"prompt":"warmup","stream":true}'`

maria-cs: perfect. can we also add a short script for prefilling common tenant prompts? CSMs love copy/paste.

ajay-eng: small node snippet ok: `await fetch('/v1/generate',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization': 'Bearer '+K,'X-Redwood-Warmup':'1'},body:JSON.stringify({prompt:'skeleton warmup',stream:true})})` keep it single-line for the doc.

ben-sre: operational notes to include:
- pre-warm only 5–10 reqs per tenant to avoid burst costs
- if you see 5%+ 503 or queueing latency -> escalate to eng-sre via #eng-oncall
- enable tenant-level telemetry tag: `tenant_id:<id>` for tracing

maria-cs: adding a tiny renewal risk checklist too: quick signals to flag to AMs — drop in weekly active calls, lower success rate on streaming, increased token error rate. Suggest next action: 1) run runbook 2) collect feedback 3) offer a 15m enablement if issues persist.

sophie-ps: feedback capture template (short):
- did response time improve after prefill? (yes/no)
- any client errors during streaming? (brief)
- top 1 ask from product/UX side
- can we trial a short reserved warmpool for 2 weeks?

maria-cs: putting that as a small checkbox list in the 1-pager. also adding links: enablement guide (internal) -> https://redwood.internal/cs/prefill-lite (placeholder) and feedback form -> https://forms.gle/example

ben-sre: minor note: include a fallback policy in the runbook text: if token costs spike, drop prefill to 1 req and increase TTL to 60s, then re-evaluate.

maria-cs: TL;DR for the 1-pager (single line to paste in handoff): "Run 3 warmup calls, enable streaming fallback, set short cache TTL, monitor 72h, escalate if errors >5% or latency regresses."

ajay-eng: also propose a tiny perf dashboard tile we can share: median p95 latency, streaming success rate, warmup hit rate. makes it easier for AMs to see impact.

sophie-ps: I'll draft the 1-pager language and post it here for quick review in ~30m. if anyone wants to add a snappy subject line for the customer email, drop it here.

maria-cs: subject idea: "Quick runbook to keep <Product> fast during renewal" — short and action-oriented.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: docs/cs/prefill-lite.md updated in canary. build #4523 succeeded :rocket:

maria-cs: awesome, thanks everyone. i'll assemble and tag @sophie-ps and @ajay-eng for final sign-off before we publish to CS wiki. :pray:
